title: Fault injection definition
description: One injection type of the simulator, exactly in the simulator's model: per-tag transforms with a state guard, a trapezoid envelope and tunable instance parameters. tag values are the manual's signal registry ids and fault_id values are the manual's cause registry ids. Never a message on its own: definitions travel inside a gt-injections document.

label.description: Menu text of the injection, shown verbatim.

benign.description: True when the cause is a normal operating condition rather than a defect.

description.description: What the injection does to the signals, in words.

default_duration_sim_min.description: Simulated minutes an instance runs when the command names no duration.

envelope.description: Trapezoid in simulated time: the magnitude rises over ramp_in_min, holds at one and falls over ramp_out_min.

params.description: The tunable instance parameters and their bounds; magnitude and duration_sim_min are the two the control plane accepts.

transforms.description: The per-tag overlays, applied in list order to every emitted row while an instance is active.

param.title: Instance parameter
param.description: One tunable parameter of an injection instance with its default and its bounds.

when.title: State guard
when.description: The machine state a transform applies in; any applies always.

stuck_value.title: Frozen value
stuck_value.description: The value a stuck or dropped-out tag reports: a number for an analog tag, a boolean for a digital one.

transform.title: Transform
transform.description: One overlay on one tag: the seven primitives of docs/simulation.md#transform-primitives. Every transform carries tag, op and when; the remaining fields are the primitive's own parameters, so every branch is closed.

value.description: Added to the analog value, scaled by the envelope magnitude.

factor.description: Multiplies the analog value; the envelope magnitude interpolates between one and this factor.

rate_per_min.description: Change per simulated minute since the anchor.

cap.description: Largest absolute deviation the ramp may reach.

anchor.description: Where the ramp counts its minutes from: injection_start counts from the instance start; state_entry restarts at every change of the machine state; guard_entry restarts each time the transform's when guard starts to hold and keeps running through changes of machine state that stay inside the guard (unloaded to off under not_loaded, for example).

sigma.description: Standard deviation of the added zero-mean noise, scaled by the envelope magnitude.

run_value.description: Which level of the digital tag is stretched or suppressed.

extend_s.description: Seconds each run of run_value is extended; a negative value suppresses that many seconds at the start of the run.
